policy.scope: All retained database profiles; original upstream submissions protected; priority languages affect review order, not ownership classification.
policy.fast_means: Lowest saved median among retained catalog candidates under the recorded configuration; never proven globally optimal. Archived candidates outside the catalog require separate review.
policy.small_means: Fewest retained application LOC under the existing accounting policy; never proof of a minimum idiomatic program.
policy.admission_status_limit: Candidate qualification is exact-source/configuration scoped; predecessor records remain unchanged, and archived correctness corrections are not new timing experiments.
policy.Mech_review_scope: Separately requested application/compiler/mode review; not part of the fifteen-language priority ordering and not a proposal for native workload executors.
policy.sample_envelope_limit: A descriptive min/max ratio across saved observations from possibly different cohorts; no confidence or causal speedup claim.
policy.unchanged_identity_limit: CLBG citation matching permits CRLF normalization and trimming only; declared-unmodified assertions are labeled separately.

optimization_checklist.requirement: Bind exact application/support hashes, source notices, original citations and known predecessors. Preserve unchanged upstream submissions; unknown lineage remains explicit.
Review semantic work and adversarial record/boundary cases, not only canonical output. Keep full inputs, all required updates/allocations, numeric order and complete output.
Review documented release/flags, JIT policy, standard APIs, scalar/array representation, boxing, copying, allocation, map lookup and bounded worker scheduling.
Retain isolated complete alternatives with distinct hashes and a stated source/runtime hypothesis; source aliases are not independent optimization strategies.
Review a native-language idiomatic form and the existing compact form; count all workload helpers under the same application boundary and retain formatter evidence separately.

Before future admission, require source/work review, arbitrary small/adversarial cases, independent reference output and full-output validation; never a native workload executor or precomputed answer.

Future measurements require separately authorized execution and the established guarded fresh-process full-size protocol, shuffled sequential rounds, bounded workers and matched Mech controls. This audit executes none.
Retain every valid sample, report medians/spread/source cost, compare fastest and smallest independently, and describe winners only within the qualified retained candidate pool.
